classes.name: opaque_archive_root
classes.parsed: observed USDT directory names in RAM only
classes.discarded: raw HTML, unadmitted identities, dates, schema keys and body hashes
classes.note: single snapshot; no C1, persisted candidate-name plan or resume

classes.name: opaque_archive_dates
classes.params: one request per in-window launch and one per archive-only candidate
classes.parsed: exact-prefix pre-cut facts, or opaque pre-cut filename identity uncertainty
classes.discarded: post-cut names, dates and counts; raw HTML, schema keys and body hashes
classes.note: plan size unknown before the root; frozen catalog subtraction, no resume

catalog_policy: frozen window symbols only; no fresh C1 subtraction
privacy: random opaque request keys; no unadmitted names, raw bodies or body hashes
identity: exact directory/file prefix only; first archived day is not a launch date
foreign_prefix: valid pre-cut foreign-prefix file blocks M2(ii); opaque issue only
restart: no resume; existing output roots are refused before HTTP
failure: any incomplete source, response, scan or budget leaves stage1_incomplete
operational_counts: attempts and bytes may vary; no post-cut launch metric is kept
